title: Removes player agency
body: Events force you to participate by stealing your hard earned items. This is a terrible mechanic, and one the developers should nix if they want people to play long term.

title: Fun until about level 50
body: I’ve been able to play without spending too much money - until about level 50. The extra games do help with gaining extra energy. However when items take so many merges to build it becomes tedious and you have to either spend money or just wait. This is typically when I lose interest. It’s a cute game with cute graphics, but I’m not willing to spend $10-$20 a day at best to keep a game going.

title: Really really like it!!
body: I was expecting another merge game that almost forces you to spend money to progress, but this game is not one of them. It flows very easily. You are actually able to win the side games, unlike many other games Ive played. You have plenty of chances to earn energy and gems. I have spent money on this game, but because I wanted to.
